content_text: One of my favorite investing use cases of Claude right now is creating quick 20-page primers on public companies I am digging into. Has become my first step whenever I first start reading a 10K A hedge fund analyst would have had to previously spend 6 hours of their day putting this together for their PM. Now Claude can do it in the span of 10 minutes. Exact prompt below Create a detailed primer on [XYZ company]. I want sections broken down into segments, YoY reporting for FY22-FY25 and then the LTM period, visuals including what the company does, value chain, competitors and competitive differentiation, comps multiple analysis, simple DCF output, capital structure, and yields on debt. The output should be a 15-20 page Word doc that is well structured with thoughtful analysis. Also include recent price catalysts and any equity research updates in recent months. Include a section for news flow in the past few quarters with key takeaways
